'''Cheerspring''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cheerlet]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Cheerstella]] at 36 stars after completing their [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Cheerspring uses gorgeous, star-shaped ears to dance, inspiring Tatari to unleash their full potential. They would never admit it, but even some [[Zobos]] are fans."

Cheerspring is a red rarity Tatari with an emphasis on bolstering its allies and reinforcing the front line. 

== Appearance ==
A white, anthropomorphic rabbit with large, red eyes. Its body is covered in purple fur, growing darker along its ears and feet. Instead of the eggshell from past evolutions, it now wears a purple vest, with a yellow medical cross emblazoned on the front. The ends of its ears have star-shaped fur, colored in the same yellow.

Cheerspring's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces the yellow on its ears and vest with bright cyan.

== Evolution Trials ==
Cheerspring's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Cheerstella]], you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play Marathon Party (Use x6000 skateboards) or Fishing Contest (Use x6000 Fishing Rods).
* Feed Cheerspring x15 Tempura Plates.

== Strategy ==
[[File:Cheerspring Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Cheerspring's Attack Range]]
The rapid healing of its skill heals 3% of each Tatari's Max HP every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds, healing each Tatari in range for 18% of their Max HP. Combined with the Invincibility, Cheerspring can now provide an effective damage buffer against otherwise deadly groups of Zobos.

Aside from this, Cheerspring largely functions the same as before.
{{clear|left}}
